research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 11195 (30 FR 1169, Federal Register of February 4, 1965), signed by Lyndon B. Johnson and dated January 30, 1965; number, title and date agree with the census register. Inventory: the dossier's seven clauses (two amendment leads, four added positions and the effective-date sentence) cover every sentence of the order; I confirm them. Under section 303(g) of the Government Employees Salary Reform Act of 1964 the order amends Executive Order 11189 of November 23, 1964 by adding to its section 1 the Chief of Protocol, Department of State, as a Level IV position and to its section 2 three Level V positions (Staff Director, Commission on Civil Rights; Assistant Director (Program Planning, Analysis, and Research), Office of Economic Opportunity; General Counsel, Veterans Administration), and takes effect immediately. Ending: Executive Order 12060 (signed 1978-05-15) revokes this order by number in its section 3, and EO 11189 by the same sentence. The first end of every clause is that express revocation; amendments continue until the amended order ends (owner ruling 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments). Section 7(c) of the same Act provides that an order in effect under a replaced law continues in effect under the corresponding provision "until repealed, amended, or superseded.", which points the other way. Bounded search read for this order: the dossier's three machine searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning (U.S. Code release point 119-121 through 2026-10-09, whose hits for this order are the historical notes under 5 U.S.C. 5315 and 5316 and the 5 U.S.C. 5317 note stating that the order was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12060; eCFR and GovInfo CFR bulk through 2026-10-14, two machine hits without located text in the dossier, not relied on; Federal Register catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts, two machine hits, both recording the EO 12060 revocation); the number-citation scan of held order texts in the packet lookups, which found the number only in the texts of this order and of EO 12060; and a full read of EO 12060 (held Federal Register text, 1,871 characters). EO 12553 does not list 11195.

savings.reason: EO 12060 has no savings, exception, pending-matter or nothing-herein wording (its full held text was read), so nothing of this order continues as a command after the revocation. The placement of the listed positions at the pay levels is carried by 5 U.S.C. 5315 and 5316 as enacted by Pub. L. 89-554, so the substance was transferred to the statute; pay received while the positions were placed by the order is accrued.
